text.en: In the PBDB snapshot, Tersomius texensis Case 1910 is recorded at species rank, with Tersomius as its listed parent. This placement comes from the database snapshot dated 2 October 2026. It is a supplementary fossil classification and does not establish equivalence with a similarly named COL concept.
text.zh: 在 PBDB 快照中，Tersomius texensis Case 1910 被记为种级，所列上级为 Tersomius。该分类取自日期为 2026 年 10 月 2 日的数据库快照。这是补充化石分类，不能据此认定它与 COL 中同名概念等同。

title.zh: 化石出现记录

text.en: The captured query returns 3 occurrence records for this exact PBDB concept, representing 3 collection IDs. Its recorded modern geographic labels are US / Texas / Baylor; US / Oklahoma / Tillman; US / Texas / Archer. The supplied interval labels are Artinskian; Kungurian; Wolfcampian. Across these collection-age intervals, the outer bounds span 298.9–274.4 million years ago. These dates describe collections in the database, not the taxon’s origin or extinction. The snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 针对这一 PBDB 分类概念，捕获查询返回 3 条出现记录，对应 3 个 collection 编号。数据库记录的现代地理标签为 US / Texas / Baylor; US / Oklahoma / Tillman; US / Texas / Archer。所给年代标签为 Artinskian; Kungurian; Wolfcampian。这些采集年龄区间的外侧边界为距今 298.9–274.4 百万年，描述的是数据库中的采集记录，不是该分类单元的起源或灭绝时间。此快照不能证明全球化石分布完整。

title.zh: 研究正文待整理

text.en: A separate literature index is recorded for this taxon, but an index documents citation searching rather than verified biological findings. This page therefore stays with the PBDB name, classification, and occurrence information above. The available record does not support adding claims about anatomy, life history, ecology, or evolutionary relationships.
text.zh: 另有文献索引记录，但索引反映的是引文检索状态，并不等于已证实的生物学发现。因此本页仅介绍上文的 PBDB 名称、分类和出现记录；现有记录不足以补写解剖、生活史、生态或演化关系。

text.en: The PBDB query returned 13 occurrence records for this concept, assigned to 13 collection IDs. These are age intervals attached to returned collections, not a measured species origin or extinction date, and the snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 本次 PBDB 查询为此概念返回 13 条出现记录，分属 13 个采集编号。记录所列现代地点为：US / Texas / Archer; US / Oklahoma / McClain; US / West Virginia / Ohio; US / West Virginia / Monongalia; US / New Mexico / Rio Arriba。记录给出的年代标签为 Artinskian; Wolfcampian; Virgilian; Virgilian–Wolfcampian。返回采集记录的年代区间外界为距今 303.7 至 283.3 百万年。这些年代区间附属于检索返回的采集记录，不是该物种起源或灭绝日期；这份快照也不能证明全球化石分布已经完整记录。

title.zh: 现有资料能说明什么

title.en: Occurrences returned for this fossil concept

text.en: The PBDB query returned 1 occurrence records for this concept, assigned to 1 collection IDs. The listed modern localities are IL. The supplied interval labels are Pelsonian. The returned collection intervals span 244.4 to 243.43 million years ago. These are age intervals attached to returned collections, not a measured species origin or extinction date, and the snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 本次 PBDB 查询为此概念返回 1 条出现记录，分属 1 个采集编号。记录所列现代地点为：IL。记录给出的年代标签为 Pelsonian。返回采集记录的年代区间外界为距今 244.4 至 243.43 百万年。这些年代区间附属于检索返回的采集记录，不是该物种起源或灭绝日期；这份快照也不能证明全球化石分布已经完整记录。

title.en: Scope of the available biological evidence
title.zh: 现有资料能说明什么

This page therefore describes the PBDB name and placement and the occurrence information returned in the captured query; it cannot support a description of anatomy, life history or ecology.

title.en: Occurrences returned for this fossil concept
title.zh: 此概念检索到的化石记录

text.en: The PBDB query returned 71 occurrence records for this concept, assigned to 69 collection IDs. The listed modern localities are US / New Mexico / Santa Fe; US / Texas / Howard; US / Arizona / Apache; US / Arizona / Navajo; US / Texas / Crosby; US / Texas / Potter; US / Wyoming / Fremont; US / Wyoming / Hot Springs; US / Arizona / Coconino; US / Pennsylvania / York. The supplied interval labels are Carnian; Carnian–Norian; Norian. The returned collection intervals span 237 to 205.7 million years ago. These are age intervals attached to returned collections, not a measured species origin or extinction date, and the snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 本次 PBDB 查询为此概念返回 71 条出现记录，分属 69 个采集编号。记录所列现代地点为：US / New Mexico / Santa Fe; US / Texas / Howard; US / Arizona / Apache; US / Arizona / Navajo; US / Texas / Crosby; US / Texas / Potter; US / Wyoming / Fremont; US / Wyoming / Hot Springs; US / Arizona / Coconino; US / Pennsylvania / York。记录给出的年代标签为 Carnian; Carnian–Norian; Norian。返回采集记录的年代区间外界为距今 237 至 205.7 百万年。这些年代区间附属于检索返回的采集记录，不是该物种起源或灭绝日期；这份快照也不能证明全球化石分布已经完整记录。

title.en: Scope of the available biological evidence
title.zh: 现有资料能说明什么

text.en: The indexed references attached to this record are bibliographic leads, not verified biological claims. This page therefore describes the PBDB name and placement and the occurrence information returned in the captured query; it cannot support a description of anatomy, life history or ecology.

title.en: PBDB placement of this fossil concept
title.zh: PBDB 对该化石分类单元的记录

text.en: In the PBDB snapshot dated 2 October 2026, Thoosuchus acutirostris (Hartmann-Weinberg and Kuzmin 1936) is listed at species rank beneath Thoosuchus. This is the database-recorded placement; the supplementary PBDB path does not equate it with a similarly named COL entry.

title.en: Occurrences returned for this fossil concept
title.zh: 此概念检索到的化石记录

text.en: The PBDB query returned 1 occurrence records for this concept, assigned to 1 collection IDs. The listed modern localities are RU / Ivanovo. The supplied interval labels are Early Triassic. The returned collection intervals span 251.902 to 247 million years ago. These are age intervals attached to returned collections, not a measured species origin or extinction date, and the snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 本次 PBDB 查询为此概念返回 1 条出现记录，分属 1 个采集编号。记录所列现代地点为：RU / Ivanovo。记录给出的年代标签为 Early Triassic。返回采集记录的年代区间外界为距今 251.902 至 247 百万年。这些年代区间附属于检索返回的采集记录，不是该物种起源或灭绝日期；这份快照也不能证明全球化石分布已经完整记录。

title.en: Scope of the available biological evidence
title.zh: 现有资料能说明什么

text.en: The indexed references attached to this record are bibliographic leads, not verified biological claims. This page therefore describes the PBDB name and placement and the occurrence information returned in the captured query; it cannot support a description of anatomy, life history or ecology.
text.zh: 此条目关联的引文索引提供书目线索，尚未形成经核对的生物学主张。因此，本页只说明 PBDB 所记名称与分类位置，以及本次捕获查询返回的出现记录；这些资料不足以描述形态、生活史或生态。

title.en: 2 PBDB occurrence rows and collection fields
title.zh: 2 条 PBDB 出现记录与采集地字段

text.en: The exact concept has 2 occurrence records and 2 distinct collection IDs: occ:906409 (collection col:101875; identified name `Callistomordax kugleri n. gen. n. sp.`; locality labels DE / Baden-Württemberg / Schwäbisch Hall; stratigraphy fields group=Keuper, formation=Erfurt, member=Upper Lettenkeuper; `olderAgeMa`=239.48 Ma, `youngerAgeMa`=237 Ma). occ:929795 (collection col:101873; locality labels DE / Baden-Württemberg / Hohenlohekreis; stratigraphy fields group=Keuper, formation=Erfurt, member=Upper Lettenkeuper; `olderAgeMa`=239.48 Ma, `youngerAgeMa`=237 Ma). Age values are collection-record fields in Ma (million years ago), not measured origin or extinction dates; this snapshot does not establish a complete global distribution. The excerpt supplies occurrence and collection IDs but no specimen identifier or specimen-level description.
text.zh: 这一确切概念返回 2 条出现记录，涉及 2 个不同采集地 ID：occ:906409 (collection col:101875; identified name `Callistomordax kugleri n. gen. n. sp.`; locality labels DE / Baden-Württemberg / Schwäbisch Hall; stratigraphy fields group=Keuper, formation=Erfurt, member=Upper Lettenkeuper; `olderAgeMa`=239.48 Ma, `youngerAgeMa`=237 Ma). occ:929795 (collection col:101873; locality labels DE / Baden-Württemberg / Hohenlohekreis; stratigraphy fields group=Keuper, formation=Erfurt, member=Upper Lettenkeuper; `olderAgeMa`=239.48 Ma, `youngerAgeMa`=237 Ma)。年代值是采集地记录中的 Ma（距今百万年）字段，不是测定的物种起源或灭绝时间；该快照不证明全球分布已完整记录。摘录提供出现记录和采集地 ID，但没有标本编号或标本层级描述。

title.zh: Callistomordax kugleri 的文献索引查询

text.en: The accepted-name lookup for `Callistomordax kugleri` reports 3 reference records in the linked index. This is bibliography metadata, not a verified biological result. This placeholder assigns no biological claim and concept equivalence is not certified; the factual account on this page is limited to the PBDB fields above.
text.zh: 链接索引中的 accepted-name 查询以 `Callistomordax kugleri` 为检索名，报告 3 条参考文献记录匹配。这是书目元数据，不是经核实的生物学结果。该占位记录尚未分配生物学主张，概念等同性尚未认证；本页事实仅限上述 PBDB 字段。

title.zh: PBDB 所记分类概念

text.en: The PBDB snapshot checked 2026-10-02 records Parotosuchus nasutus at species rank (source concept txn:138609), beneath the recorded parent Parotosuchus. This is the database parent chain stored under the Amphibia anchor; the path does not certify equivalence with a COL26.8 concept.

title.en: 1 PBDB occurrence rows and collection fields
title.zh: 1 条 PBDB 出现记录与采集地字段

text.en: The exact concept has 1 occurrence record and 1 distinct collection ID: occ:1419107 (collection col:196668; identified name `Capitosaurus nasutus n. sp.` (taxonomicDifference: `recombined as`); locality labels DE / Sachsen-Anhalt / Salzlandkreis; stratigraphy fields group=Middle Buntsandstein, formation=Solling, member=Bausandstein; `olderAgeMa`=248.6 Ma, `youngerAgeMa`=247 Ma). Age values are collection-record fields in Ma (million years ago), not measured origin or extinction dates; this snapshot does not establish a complete global distribution. The excerpt supplies occurrence and collection IDs but no specimen identifier or specimen-level description.
text.zh: 这一确切概念返回 1 条出现记录，涉及 1 个不同采集地 ID：occ:1419107 (collection col:196668; identified name `Capitosaurus nasutus n. sp.` (taxonomicDifference: `recombined as`); locality labels DE / Sachsen-Anhalt / Salzlandkreis; stratigraphy fields group=Middle Buntsandstein, formation=Solling, member=Bausandstein; `olderAgeMa`=248.6 Ma, `youngerAgeMa`=247 Ma)。年代值是采集地记录中的 Ma（距今百万年）字段，不是测定的物种起源或灭绝时间；该快照不证明全球分布已完整记录。摘录提供出现记录和采集地 ID，但没有标本编号或标本层级描述。

title.zh: Parotosuchus nasutus 的文献索引查询

This placeholder assigns no biological claim and concept equivalence is not certified; the factual account on this page is limited to the PBDB fields above.

title.en: PBDB placement of this fossil concept
title.zh: PBDB 对该化石分类单元的记录

text.en: In the PBDB snapshot dated 2 October 2026, Parotosuchus orenburgensis (Konzhukova 1968) is listed at species rank beneath Parotosuchus. This is the database-recorded placement; the supplementary PBDB path does not equate it with a similarly named COL entry.
text.zh: 按 2026 年 10 月 2 日的 PBDB 快照，Parotosuchus orenburgensis (Konzhukova 1968) 被记为 species 级，位于 Parotosuchus 之下。这是数据库所记的分类位置；补充 PBDB 路径不表示它与 COL 中同名条目等同。

title.en: Occurrences returned for this fossil concept
title.zh: 此概念检索到的化石记录

text.en: The PBDB query returned 2 occurrence records for this concept, assigned to 2 collection IDs. The listed modern localities are RU / Orenburg / Ilekskii; RU / Orenburg / Sol'-Iletsk. The supplied interval labels are Olenekian; Spathian. The returned collection intervals span 250.8 to 247 million years ago. These are age intervals attached to returned collections, not a measured species origin or extinction date, and the snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 本次 PBDB 查询为此概念返回 2 条出现记录，分属 2 个采集编号。记录所列现代地点为：RU / Orenburg / Ilekskii; RU / Orenburg / Sol'-Iletsk。记录给出的年代标签为 Olenekian; Spathian。返回采集记录的年代区间外界为距今 250.8 至 247 百万年。这些年代区间附属于检索返回的采集记录，不是该物种起源或灭绝日期；这份快照也不能证明全球化石分布已经完整记录。

title.en: Scope of the available biological evidence
title.zh: 现有资料能说明什么

text.en: The indexed references attached to this record are bibliographic leads, not verified biological claims. This page therefore describes the PBDB name and placement and the occurrence information returned in the captured query; it cannot support a description of anatomy, life history or ecology.
text.zh: 此条目关联的引文索引提供书目线索，尚未形成经核对的生物学主张。因此，本页只说明 PBDB 所记名称与分类位置，以及本次捕获查询返回的出现记录；这些资料不足以描述形态、生活史或生态。

Its recorded modern geographic labels are US / Oklahoma / Atoka; US / Texas / Montague; US / Texas / Wise. The supplied interval labels are Late Aptian–Early Albian; Albian. Across these collection-age intervals, the outer bounds span 119.57–100.5 million years ago. These dates describe collections in the database, not the taxon’s origin or extinction. The snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.

text.en: In the PBDB snapshot dated 2 October 2026, Albanerpeton ektopistikon Carrano et al. 2022 is listed at species rank beneath Albanerpeton. This is the database-recorded placement; the supplementary PBDB path does not equate it with a similarly named COL entry.

title.en: Occurrences returned for this fossil concept
title.zh: 此概念检索到的化石记录

text.en: The PBDB query returned 3 occurrence records for this concept, assigned to 3 collection IDs. The listed modern localities are US / Wyoming / Big Horn. The supplied interval labels are Albian; Aptian–Albian. The returned collection intervals span 121.4 to 100.5 million years ago. These are age intervals attached to returned collections, not a measured species origin or extinction date, and the snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 本次 PBDB 查询为此概念返回 3 条出现记录，分属 3 个采集编号。记录所列现代地点为：US / Wyoming / Big Horn。记录给出的年代标签为 Albian; Aptian–Albian。返回采集记录的年代区间外界为距今 121.4 至 100.5 百万年。这些年代区间附属于检索返回的采集记录，不是该物种起源或灭绝日期；这份快照也不能证明全球化石分布已经完整记录。

title.zh: 来源记载的化石概念

text.en: In the PBDB snapshot, Albanerpeton nexuosus Estes 1981 is recorded at species rank, with Albanerpeton as its listed parent. This placement comes from the database snapshot dated 2 October 2026. It is a supplementary fossil classification and does not establish equivalence with a similarly named COL concept.
text.zh: 在 PBDB 快照中，Albanerpeton nexuosus Estes 1981 被记为种级，所列上级为 Albanerpeton。该分类取自日期为 2026 年 10 月 2 日的数据库快照。这是补充化石分类，不能据此认定它与 COL 中同名概念等同。

title.zh: 化石出现记录

text.en: The captured query returns 29 occurrence records for this exact PBDB concept, representing 28 collection IDs. Its recorded modern geographic labels are US / Utah / Emery; US / Colorado / Weld; ES / Aragón / Huesca; US / Wyoming / Niobrara; CA / Alberta; US / Utah / Kane; US / Utah / Garfield; US / Texas / Brewster; US / New Mexico / San Juan; US / Wyoming / Sweetwater; US / Montana / McCone County; CA / Alberta / County of Warner; US / Montana / Powder River; US / Montana / Garfield. The supplied interval labels are Early Cenomanian; Lancian; Late Maastrichtian; Middle Campanian; Late Campanian; Judithian; Late Santonian; Middle Cenomanian–Late Cenomanian; Early Campanian. Across these collection-age intervals, the outer bounds span 100.5–66 million years ago. These dates describe collections in the database, not the taxon’s origin or extinction. The snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 针对这一 PBDB 分类概念，捕获查询返回 29 条出现记录，对应 28 个 collection 编号。数据库记录的现代地理标签为 US / Utah / Emery; US / Colorado / Weld; ES / Aragón / Huesca; US / Wyoming / Niobrara; CA / Alberta; US / Utah / Kane; US / Utah / Garfield; US / Texas / Brewster; US / New Mexico / San Juan; US / Wyoming / Sweetwater; US / Montana / McCone County; CA / Alberta / County of Warner; US / Montana / Powder River; US / Montana / Garfield。所给年代标签为 Early Cenomanian; Lancian; Late Maastrichtian; Middle Campanian; Late Campanian; Judithian; Late Santonian; Middle Cenomanian–Late Cenomanian; Early Campanian。这些采集年龄区间的外侧边界为距今 100.5–66 百万年，描述的是数据库中的采集记录，不是该分类单元的起源或灭绝时间。此快照不能证明全球化石分布完整。

title.zh: 研究正文待整理

text.en: A separate literature index is recorded for this taxon, but an index documents citation searching rather than verified biological findings. This page therefore stays with the PBDB name, classification, and occurrence information above. The available record does not support adding claims about anatomy, life history, ecology, or evolutionary relationships.

text.en: In the PBDB snapshot, Uberabatrachus carvalhoi Báez et al. 2012 is recorded at species rank, with Uberabatrachus as its listed parent. This placement comes from the database snapshot dated 2 October 2026. It is a supplementary fossil classification and does not establish equivalence with a similarly named COL concept.

title.zh: 化石出现记录

text.en: The captured query returns 1 occurrence records for this exact PBDB concept, representing 1 collection IDs. Its recorded modern geographic labels are BR / Minas Gerais / Uberaba. The supplied interval labels are Late Maastrichtian. Across these collection-age intervals, the outer bounds span 72.2–66 million years ago. These dates describe collections in the database, not the taxon’s origin or extinction. The snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 针对这一 PBDB 分类概念，捕获查询返回 1 条出现记录，对应 1 个 collection 编号。数据库记录的现代地理标签为 BR / Minas Gerais / Uberaba。所给年代标签为 Late Maastrichtian。这些采集年龄区间的外侧边界为距今 72.2–66 百万年，描述的是数据库中的采集记录，不是该分类单元的起源或灭绝时间。此快照不能证明全球化石分布完整。

title.zh: 研究正文待整理

text.en: A separate literature index is recorded for this taxon, but an index documents citation searching rather than verified biological findings. This page therefore stays with the PBDB name, classification, and occurrence information above. The available record does not support adding claims about anatomy, life history, ecology, or evolutionary relationships.

Age values are collection-record fields in Ma (million years ago), not measured origin or extinction dates; this snapshot does not establish a complete global distribution. The excerpt supplies occurrence and collection IDs but no specimen identifier or specimen-level description.
text.zh: 这一确切概念返回 1 条出现记录，涉及 1 个不同采集地 ID：occ:1341213 (collection col:179194; identified name `Bufo serratus n. sp.`; locality labels FR / Languedoc-Roussillon-Midi-Pyrénées / Lot; stratigraphy fields formation=Quercy Phosphorites; `olderAgeMa`=37.71 Ma, `youngerAgeMa`=15.98 Ma)。年代值是采集地记录中的 Ma（距今百万年）字段，不是测定的物种起源或灭绝时间；该快照不证明全球分布已完整记录。摘录提供出现记录和采集地 ID，但没有标本编号或标本层级描述。

title.en: Occurrences returned for this fossil concept
title.zh: 此概念检索到的化石记录

text.en: The PBDB query returned 7 occurrence records for this concept, assigned to 7 collection IDs. text.zh: 本次 PBDB 查询为此概念返回 7 条出现记录，分属 7 个采集编号。记录所列现代地点为：US / Nebraska / Brown; US / Nebraska / Cherry; US / Kansas / Trego; CA / Saskatchewan; US / Nebraska / Banner; US / Nebraska / Antelope。记录给出的年代标签为 Barstovian; Clarendonian。返回采集记录的年代区间外界为距今 16.3 至 9.4 百万年。这些年代区间附属于检索返回的采集记录，不是该物种起源或灭绝日期；这份快照也不能证明全球化石分布已经完整记录。

title.en: Scope of the available biological evidence
title.zh: 现有资料能说明什么

text.en: The indexed references attached to this record are bibliographic leads, not verified biological claims. These are age intervals attached to returned collections, not a measured species origin or extinction date, and the snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.

title.zh: 来源记载的化石概念

text.en: In the PBDB snapshot, Batrachosauroides dissimulans Taylor and Hesse 1943 is recorded at species rank, with Batrachosauroides as its listed parent. This placement comes from the database snapshot dated 2 October 2026. It is a supplementary fossil classification and does not establish equivalence with a similarly named COL concept.
text.zh: 在 PBDB 快照中，Batrachosauroides dissimulans Taylor and Hesse 1943 被记为种级，所列上级为 Batrachosauroides。该分类取自日期为 2026 年 10 月 2 日的数据库快照。这是补充化石分类，不能据此认定它与 COL 中同名概念等同。

title.zh: 化石出现记录

text.en: The captured query returns 4 occurrence records for this exact PBDB concept, representing 4 collection IDs. Its recorded modern geographic labels are US / Texas / Polk; US / Florida / Gadsen; US / Texas / San Jacinto; US / Delaware / Kent. The supplied interval labels are Barstovian; Early Barstovian; Hemingfordian; Burdigalian. Across these collection-age intervals, the outer bounds span 20.45–12.5 million years ago. These dates describe collections in the database, not the taxon’s origin or extinction. The snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 针对这一 PBDB 分类概念，捕获查询返回 4 条出现记录，对应 4 个 collection 编号。数据库记录的现代地理标签为 US / Texas / Polk; US / Florida / Gadsen; US / Texas / San Jacinto; US / Delaware / Kent。所给年代标签为 Barstovian; Early Barstovian; Hemingfordian; Burdigalian。这些采集年龄区间的外侧边界为距今 20.45–12.5 百万年，描述的是数据库中的采集记录，不是该分类单元的起源或灭绝时间。此快照不能证明全球化石分布完整。

title.zh: 研究正文待整理

text.en: A separate literature index is recorded for this taxon, but an index documents citation searching rather than verified biological findings. This page therefore stays with the PBDB name, classification, and occurrence information above. The available record does not support adding claims about anatomy, life history, ecology, or evolutionary relationships.
text.zh: 另有文献索引记录，但索引反映的是引文检索状态，并不等于已证实的生物学发现。因此本页仅介绍上文的 PBDB 名称、分类和出现记录；现有记录不足以补写解剖、生活史、生态或演化关系。

title.zh: 来源记载的化石概念

text.en: In the PBDB snapshot, Parrisia neocesariensis Denton and O'Neill 1998 is recorded at species rank, with Parrisia as its listed parent. This placement comes from the database snapshot dated 2 October 2026. It is a supplementary fossil classification and does not establish equivalence with a similarly named COL concept.
text.zh: 在 PBDB 快照中，Parrisia neocesariensis Denton and O'Neill 1998 被记为种级，所列上级为 Parrisia。该分类取自日期为 2026 年 10 月 2 日的数据库快照。这是补充化石分类，不能据此认定它与 COL 中同名概念等同。

title.zh: 化石出现记录

text.en: The captured query returns 2 occurrence records for this exact PBDB concept, representing 1 collection IDs. Its recorded modern geographic labels are US / New Jersey / Monmouth. The supplied interval labels are Late Campanian. Across these collection-age intervals, the outer bounds span 83.6–72.2 million years ago. These dates describe collections in the database, not the taxon’s origin or extinction. The snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 针对这一 PBDB 分类概念，捕获查询返回 2 条出现记录，对应 1 个 collection 编号。数据库记录的现代地理标签为 US / New Jersey / Monmouth。所给年代标签为 Late Campanian。这些采集年龄区间的外侧边界为距今 83.6–72.2 百万年，描述的是数据库中的采集记录，不是该分类单元的起源或灭绝时间。此快照不能证明全球化石分布完整。

title.zh: 研究正文待整理

text.en: A separate literature index is recorded for this taxon, but an index documents citation searching rather than verified biological findings. This page therefore stays with the PBDB name, classification, and occurrence information above. The available record does not support adding claims about anatomy, life history, ecology, or evolutionary relationships.

title.zh: 化石出现记录

text.en: The PBDB snapshot links 1 occurrence rows to 1 collection IDs. Recorded locality labels include DE / Rheinland-Pfalz. Stratigraphic fields include Enspel. The listed collection intervals extend from the oldest bound, 27.3 Ma, to the youngest bound, 23.04 Ma (Ma means million years ago). These ages and places belong to the listed database records; they are not a measured origin, extinction date, or complete global range for the taxon.
text.zh: PBDB 快照将 1 条出现记录关联到 1 个采集地 ID。记录中的地点标签包括 DE / Rheinland-Pfalz。地层字段包括 Enspel。所列采集地年代区间的较老外侧边界为 27.3 Ma，较新外侧边界为 23.04 Ma（Ma 表示距今百万年）。这些年代与地点属于所列数据库记录，不能当作测定的起源、灭绝时间或完整全球分布。

title.en: Honeycomb-like sculpture distinguishes the cited robustus material
title.zh: 蜂窝样雕纹区别所引 robustus 材料

text.en: The paper describes robustus as having honeycomb-like sculpture across bones exposed to the skin, contrasting with predominantly pustular relief in most other Chelotriton material. Its vertebral spine tables are cited as wide plates with pits and very fine pustules. MB.Am.45 combines mostly pustular surfaces with a more honeycomb-like maxillary region; that mixture is not a robustus identification. These are literature-based comparative features, not a new population sample or measurements of skin itself. The authors leave the developmental significance of the sculpture differences uncertain.
text.zh: 论文描述 robustus 与皮肤接触骨面为蜂窝样雕纹，与多数其他 Chelotriton 主要瘤状浮纹对照。其椎骨神经棘顶板引述为带凹窝及细小瘤点的宽板。MB.Am.45 结合多数瘤状骨面及较蜂窝样颌骨区，不是 robustus 鉴定。这些是文献比较特征，不是新种群样本或皮肤本身测量。作者保留雕纹差异发育意义不确定。

title.en: Ossified wrists are a cited comparison, not a growth curve
title.zh: 骨化腕部是引述比较而非生长曲线

text.en: Robustus is among the taxa cited as having ossified wrist elements, alongside other fossil and living newts. The observation does not determine an age at ossification, developmental rate or complete digit formula for the species. Its relatively small honeycomb-sculptured vertebrae are contrasted with larger pustular vertebrae assigned paradoxus, but body-size differences cannot alone resolve ontogeny or species boundaries. MB.Am.45’s humerus, ulna and radius lengths remain with that unassigned specimen rather than being copied to robustus.
text.zh: robustus 与其他化石及现生蝾螈一起，被引述有骨化腕部；该观察不确定骨化年龄、发育速率或本种完整指骨式。其较小蜂窝雕纹椎骨与较大、归 paradoxus 的瘤状椎骨对照，但体型差异本身不能解决个体发育或种界。MB.Am.45 的肱骨、尺骨、桡骨长度保留在未归种标本，不能复制给 robustus。

heading.en: Honeycomb-like sculpture distinguishes the cited robustus material
heading.zh: 蜂窝样雕纹区别所引 robustus 材料

sectionEvidence.locator: PMC4589347 XML sec011 paragraph 0; sec014 paragraph 1; sec020 paragraph 10

evidenceSummary.en: The paper describes robustus as having honeycomb-like sculpture across bones exposed to the skin, contrasting with predominantly pustular relief in most other Chelotriton material. Its vertebral spine tables are cited as wide plates with pits and very fine pustules. MB.Am.45 combines mostly pustular surfaces with a more honeycomb-like maxillary region; that mixture is not a robustus identification. These are literature-based comparative features, not a new population sample or measurements of skin itself. The authors leave the developmental significance of the sculpture differences uncertain.
evidenceSummary.zh: 论文描述 robustus 与皮肤接触骨面为蜂窝样雕纹，与多数其他 Chelotriton 主要瘤状浮纹对照。其椎骨神经棘顶板引述为带凹窝及细小瘤点的宽板。MB.Am.45 结合多数瘤状骨面及较蜂窝样颌骨区，不是 robustus 鉴定。这些是文献比较特征，不是新种群样本或皮肤本身测量。作者保留雕纹差异发育意义不确定。

heading.en: Ossified wrists are a cited comparison, not a growth curve
heading.zh: 骨化腕部是引述比较而非生长曲线

sectionEvidence.locator: PMC4589347 XML sec014 paragraph 3; sec020 paragraphs 8, 10

evidenceSummary.en: Robustus is among the taxa cited as having ossified wrist elements, alongside other fossil and living newts. The observation does not determine an age at ossification, developmental rate or complete digit formula for the species. Its relatively small honeycomb-sculptured vertebrae are contrasted with larger pustular vertebrae assigned paradoxus, but body-size differences cannot alone resolve ontogeny or species boundaries. MB.Am.45’s humerus, ulna and radius lengths remain with that unassigned specimen rather than being copied to robustus.
evidenceSummary.zh: robustus 与其他化石及现生蝾螈一起，被引述有骨化腕部；该观察不确定骨化年龄、发育速率或本种完整指骨式。其较小蜂窝雕纹椎骨与较大、归 paradoxus 的瘤状椎骨对照，但体型差异本身不能解决个体发育或种界。MB.Am.45 的肱骨、尺骨、桡骨长度保留在未归种标本，不能复制给 robustus。

title.zh: 来源记载的化石概念

text.en: In the PBDB snapshot, Chelotriton paradoxus Pomel 1853 is recorded at species rank, with Chelotriton as its listed parent. This placement comes from the database snapshot dated 2 October 2026. It is a supplementary fossil classification and does not establish equivalence with a similarly named COL concept.
text.zh: 在 PBDB 快照中，Chelotriton paradoxus Pomel 1853 被记为种级，所列上级为 Chelotriton。该分类取自日期为 2026 年 10 月 2 日的数据库快照。这是补充化石分类，不能据此认定它与 COL 中同名概念等同。

title.zh: 化石出现记录

text.en: The captured query returns 11 occurrence records for this exact PBDB concept, representing 11 collection IDs. Its recorded modern geographic labels are DE; RO / Arad; FR; DE / Baden-Württemberg / Heidenheim; AT; PL / Silesia; DE / North Rhine-Westfalia / Rhein-Sieg; AT / Burgenland; RU / Adygea / Maykop District; UA / Khmel'nitsk'yi / Shepetivka. The supplied interval labels are MN 5; Sarmatian; Chattian; Langhian–Serravallian; MP 30; MN 11; Late Miocene; Vallesian. Across these collection-age intervals, the outer bounds span 27.3–5.333 million years ago. These dates describe collections in the database, not the taxon’s origin or extinction. The snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 针对这一 PBDB 分类概念，捕获查询返回 11 条出现记录，对应 11 个 collection 编号。数据库记录的现代地理标签为 DE; RO / Arad; FR; DE / Baden-Württemberg / Heidenheim; AT; PL / Silesia; DE / North Rhine-Westfalia / Rhein-Sieg; AT / Burgenland; RU / Adygea / Maykop District; UA / Khmel'nitsk'yi / Shepetivka。所给年代标签为 MN 5; Sarmatian; Chattian; Langhian–Serravallian; MP 30; MN 11; Late Miocene; Vallesian。这些采集年龄区间的外侧边界为距今 27.3–5.333 百万年，描述的是数据库中的采集记录，不是该分类单元的起源或灭绝时间。此快照不能证明全球化石分布完整。

title.en: A familiar species label conceals unresolved fossil assignments
title.zh: 熟悉种名之下有未解决化石归属

text.en: The 2015 paper challenges earlier placement of the Orsberg specimen MB.Am.45 in paradoxus and retains it as Chelotriton sp. Comparisons distinguish neotype-locality material from Enspel and Randeck skeletons traditionally assigned the same name. Thus the 18-by-35-mm skull, extreme posterior jaw joints and forelimb lengths of MB.Am.45 are not paradoxus measurements. The database concept remains retained for navigation, while original specimen identity requires a separate revision. The article’s arguments do not establish a newly named species or complete the reconciliation of every database occurrence.
text.zh: 2015 年论文质疑此前将 Orsberg 标本 MB.Am.45 放入 paradoxus，保留为 Chelotriton sp.。比较将新模产地材料与传统归入同名的 Enspel、Randeck 骨骼分开。因此 MB.Am.45 十八乘三十五毫米头骨、极后移颌关节及前肢长度不是 paradoxus 测量。数据库概念保留导航，原标本身份仍需独立修订。论文论证没有建立新命名物种，也未完成每条数据库出现记录核对。

title.en: Neotype-locality comparisons have their own anatomical scope
title.zh: 新模产地比较有自身解剖范围

text.en: The source cites two to four processes per rib in paradoxus material from the neotype locality and an approximately 30–35° orientation of a frontal process to the sagittal plane. Those are comparative reports from particular material, not a universal adult diagnosis or directly remeasured specimens here. The paper records uncertain or variable vertebral and cranial characters across the genus, including preservation-dependent differences. It does not transfer the genus diagnosis’s body-length range or MB.Am.45’s incomplete wrist and digit anatomy to every paradoxus fossil.
text.zh: 来源引述 paradoxus 新模产地材料每肋二至四突，以及额骨突相对矢状面约三十至三十五度方向。这是特定材料比较报告，不是通用成体诊断，也不是这里直接重测标本。论文记录属内不定或可变椎骨、头骨性状，含保存相关差别。不能将属诊断体长范围或 MB.Am.45 不完整腕指解剖转移至每个 paradoxus 化石。

title.en: Historical metamorphosis interpretations were revised for referred material
title.zh: 归入材料的历史变态解释曾修订

text.en: Some skeletons traditionally called paradoxus were earlier interpreted as having a fully metamorphosed hyobranchial apparatus; later cited work interpreted Enspel and Randeck material as retaining larval components. The 2015 discussion uses this as a comparative mosaic-development example. It does not demonstrate that every paradoxus population was paedomorphic, establish a larval duration or measure breeding biology. Because the same paper questions several species assignments, developmental interpretation and the recorded name must remain separate evidence fields.
text.zh: 传统称 paradoxus 的一些骨骼，较早被解释为舌鳃装置完全变态；后来引述研究将 Enspel、Randeck 材料解释为保留幼体部分。2015 年讨论将其用于比较镶嵌发育实例，没有证明每个 paradoxus 种群幼态保持、确定幼体年限或测繁殖生物学。论文同时质疑多个种级归属，因此发育解释与记录名称应保留为独立证据。

title.en: The 2020 study labels its paradoxus association tentative
title.zh: 2020 年研究将 paradoxus 关联标为暂定

text.en: Seven Enspel fossils and one Randeck fossil were tentatively associated with paradoxus, following cited earlier work. Their differing skull shapes prompted the suggestion that the deposits may contain different species, and the authors state that named Chelotriton species await validation. Consequently, the study’s pooled fossil shape and size comparisons cannot be certified as a single paradoxus population trait. This preserves the earlier 2015 concerns about historical assignments rather than silently treating a later citation as final identity confirmation.
text.zh: 依引述较早工作，Enspel 七个、Randeck 一个化石暂与 paradoxus 关联。不同头骨形状促成两地点或含不同种的建议，作者记具名 Chelotriton 种仍待验证。因此所合并化石形状及大小比较不能认证为单一 paradoxus 种群性状。这保留 2015 年对历史归属的疑问，不把较晚引用悄然当作最终身份确认。

title.en: Deposit ages and reconstructed skulls have distinct evidence roles
title.zh: 沉积年代与重建头骨具有不同证据角色

text.en: The cited 24.8–24.6-million-year Enspel interval and 17–15-million-year Randeck interval date the sampled deposits. They do not show continuous occupation by one species between those ages. Shape analysis included estimated missing landmarks and symmetrization of distorted Enspel fossils, and post-hoc comparisons omitted the single Randeck sample. Palaeoclimate and terrestrial-life interpretations belong to the comparative study, not independently established paradoxus thermal limits or directly preserved reproductive behaviour.
text.zh: 引述 Enspel 24.8–24.6 百万年及 Randeck 十七至十五百万年区间是所采沉积年代，不证明同一种在两年代间连续占据。形状分析包含缺失标志点估计及变形 Enspel 化石对称化，事后比较排除 Randeck 单样本。古气候及陆生解释属于比较研究，不是独立建立的 paradoxus 耐温或直接保存繁殖行为。

title.zh: 研究正文待整理

text.en: A separate literature index is recorded for this taxon, but an index documents citation searching rather than verified biological findings. This page therefore stays with the PBDB name, classification, and occurrence information above. The available record does not support adding claims about anatomy, life history, ecology, or evolutionary relationships.
text.zh: 另有文献索引记录，但索引反映的是引文检索状态，并不等于已证实的生物学发现。因此本页仅介绍上文的 PBDB 名称、分类和出现记录；现有记录不足以补写解剖、生活史、生态或演化关系。

evidenceSummary.zh: 传统称 paradoxus 的一些骨骼，较早被解释为舌鳃装置完全变态；后来引述研究将 Enspel、Randeck 材料解释为保留幼体部分。2015 年讨论将其用于比较镶嵌发育实例，没有证明每个 paradoxus 种群幼态保持、确定幼体年限或测繁殖生物学。论文同时质疑多个种级归属，因此发育解释与记录名称应保留为独立证据。

sectionEvidence.locator: PMC7369190 section 0 paragraph 0; section 5 paragraph 3; XML joa13201-sec-0008 paragraphs 0–1

evidenceSummary.en: Seven Enspel fossils and one Randeck fossil were tentatively associated with paradoxus, following cited earlier work. Their differing skull shapes prompted the suggestion that the deposits may contain different species, and the authors state that named Chelotriton species await validation. Consequently, the study’s pooled fossil shape and size comparisons cannot be certified as a single paradoxus population trait. This preserves the earlier 2015 concerns about historical assignments rather than silently treating a later citation as final identity confirmation.
evidenceSummary.zh: 依引述较早工作，Enspel 七个、Randeck 一个化石暂与 paradoxus 关联。不同头骨形状促成两地点或含不同种的建议，作者记具名 Chelotriton 种仍待验证。因此所合并化石形状及大小比较不能认证为单一 paradoxus 种群性状。这保留 2015 年对历史归属的疑问，不把较晚引用悄然当作最终身份确认。

heading.en: Deposit ages and reconstructed skulls have distinct evidence roles
heading.zh: 沉积年代与重建头骨具有不同证据角色

sectionEvidence.locator: PMC7369190 section 1 paragraph 1; section 2 paragraph 0; XML joa13201-sec-0009 paragraph 1; joa13201-sec-0012 paragraphs 2–3

evidenceSummary.en: The cited 24.8–24.6-million-year Enspel interval and 17–15-million-year Randeck interval date the sampled deposits. They do not show continuous occupation by one species between those ages. Shape analysis included estimated missing landmarks and symmetrization of distorted Enspel fossils, and post-hoc comparisons omitted the single Randeck sample. Palaeoclimate and terrestrial-life interpretations belong to the comparative study, not independently established paradoxus thermal limits or directly preserved reproductive behaviour.
evidenceSummary.zh: 引述 Enspel 24.8–24.6 百万年及 Randeck 十七至十五百万年区间是所采沉积年代，不证明同一种在两年代间连续占据。形状分析包含缺失标志点估计及变形 Enspel 化石对称化，事后比较排除 Randeck 单样本。古气候及陆生解释属于比较研究，不是独立建立的 paradoxus 耐温或直接保存繁殖行为。

title.zh: PBDB 所记分类概念

text.en: The PBDB snapshot checked 2026-10-02 records Chelotriton ogygius at species rank (source concept txn:393932), beneath the recorded parent Chelotriton. This is the database parent chain stored under the Amphibia anchor; the path does not certify equivalence with a COL26.8 concept.
text.zh: PBDB 于 2026-10-02 核对的快照将 Chelotriton ogygius 记为 species 级概念（来源概念 txn:393932），其记录父级为 Chelotriton。这是 Amphibia 存储锚点下的数据库父链；该路径不认证其与 COL26.8 概念等同。

title.en: 0 PBDB occurrence rows and collection fields
title.zh: 0 条 PBDB 出现记录与采集地字段

text.en: This PBDB snapshot excerpt returns no occurrence rows for the exact concept. It therefore supplies no collection, locality or age fields here; a zero-row result is not evidence that the taxon left no fossils.
text.zh: 该 PBDB 快照摘录未返回这一确切概念的出现记录，因此此处没有采集地、地点或年代字段；零条查询结果不证明该类群没有留下化石。

title.en: An apparently lost type limits comparison at Orsberg
title.zh: 模式似已遗失，限制 Orsberg 比较

text.en: The 2015 authors state that ogygius came from the same locality as MB.Am.45, but comparison is hampered by the apparent loss of its type and only known specimen. The old specimen was illustrated in ventral view, whereas MB.Am.45 preserves dorsal anatomy. Shared locality is therefore not proof of shared species identity, and MB.Am.45’s new cast is not a replacement ogygius type. The bounded empty occurrence query in the database reader does not erase this historical literature record; neither source proves a complete geographic or temporal range.
text.zh: 2015 年作者记 ogygius 与 MB.Am.45 来自同一地点，但模式及唯一已知标本似已遗失，限制比较。旧标本图为腹面，MB.Am.45 保存背面解剖。共享地点不证明同种，新 MB.Am.45 翻模也不是替代 ogygius 模式。数据库读本限定查询未返出现记录，不消除这一历史文献记录；二者都不证明完整地理或时间范围。

title.en: A historical vertebral count is an estimate from incomplete material
title.zh: 历史椎骨数是部分材料估计

text.en: The paper recounts an older estimate of twelve presacral vertebrae for ogygius: the first ten were preserved, with presumed sacral and proximal tail vertebrae separated by a gap. This remains a historical reconstruction, rather than a new verified count or invariant species character. Other Chelotriton material was reported with different sacral positions, and the authors note vertebral variation even among living salamanders. Without comparable type material, the 2015 study neither resolves ogygius identity nor supplies its feeding, reproduction or growth chronology.
text.zh: 论文转述 ogygius 较早荐前椎十二枚估计：前十枚保存，推定荐椎及近端尾椎之间有缺口。这是历史重建，不是新核实计数或恒定物种性状。其他 Chelotriton 材料有不同荐椎位置报告，作者提醒现生蝾螈也有椎数变化。缺少可比模式材料，2015 年研究未解决 ogygius 身份，也未提供取食、繁殖或生长年代。

title.zh: Chelotriton ogygius 的文献索引查询

text.en: The accepted-name lookup for `Chelotriton ogygius` reports 2 reference records in the linked index. This is bibliography metadata, not a verified biological result. This placeholder assigns no biological claim and concept equivalence is not certified; the factual account on this page is limited to the PBDB fields above.
text.zh: 链接索引中的 accepted-name 查询以 `Chelotriton ogygius` 为检索名，报告 2 条参考文献记录匹配。这是书目元数据，不是经核实的生物学结果。该占位记录尚未分配生物学主张，概念等同性尚未认证；本页事实仅限上述 PBDB 字段。

These dates describe collections in the database, not the taxon’s origin or extinction. The snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.

text.en: In the PBDB snapshot, Piceoerpeton willwoodense Meszoely 1967 is recorded at species rank, with Piceoerpeton as its listed parent. This placement comes from the database snapshot dated 2 October 2026. It is a supplementary fossil classification and does not establish equivalence with a similarly named COL concept.
text.zh: 在 PBDB 快照中，Piceoerpeton willwoodense Meszoely 1967 被记为种级，所列上级为 Piceoerpeton。该分类取自日期为 2026 年 10 月 2 日的数据库快照。这是补充化石分类，不能据此认定它与 COL 中同名概念等同。

title.zh: 化石出现记录

text.en: The captured query returns 13 occurrence records for this exact PBDB concept, representing 13 collection IDs. Its recorded modern geographic labels are US / Wyoming / Big Horn; US / North Dakota / Billings; CA / Northwest Territories; US / Wyoming / Park; CA / Saskatchewan; US / Montana / Carter; CA / Alberta; US / North Dakota / Grant; US / Montana / Powder River. The supplied interval labels are Clarkforkian; Tiffanian; Wasatchian; Ti4. Across these collection-age intervals, the outer bounds span 60.9–51.1 million years ago. These dates describe collections in the database, not the taxon’s origin or extinction. The snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 针对这一 PBDB 分类概念，捕获查询返回 13 条出现记录，对应 13 个 collection 编号。数据库记录的现代地理标签为 US / Wyoming / Big Horn; US / North Dakota / Billings; CA / Northwest Territories; US / Wyoming / Park; CA / Saskatchewan; US / Montana / Carter; CA / Alberta; US / North Dakota / Grant; US / Montana / Powder River。所给年代标签为 Clarkforkian; Tiffanian; Wasatchian; Ti4。这些采集年龄区间的外侧边界为距今 60.9–51.1 百万年，描述的是数据库中的采集记录，不是该分类单元的起源或灭绝时间。此快照不能证明全球化石分布完整。

title.en: PBDB placement of this fossil concept
title.zh: PBDB 对该化石分类单元的记录

text.en: In the PBDB snapshot dated 2 October 2026, Horezmia gracile Nessov 1981 is listed at species rank beneath Horezmia. This is the database-recorded placement; the supplementary PBDB path does not equate it with a similarly named COL entry.
text.zh: 按 2026 年 10 月 2 日的 PBDB 快照，Horezmia gracile Nessov 1981 被记为 species 级，位于 Horezmia 之下。这是数据库所记的分类位置；补充 PBDB 路径不表示它与 COL 中同名条目等同。

title.en: Occurrences returned for this fossil concept
title.zh: 此概念检索到的化石记录

text.en: The PBDB query returned 3 occurrence records for this concept, assigned to 3 collection IDs. The listed modern localities are UZ / Navoi; UZ / Karakalpakstan. The supplied interval labels are Early Cenomanian. The returned collection intervals span 100.5 to 93.9 million years ago. These are age intervals attached to returned collections, not a measured species origin or extinction date, and the snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 本次 PBDB 查询为此概念返回 3 条出现记录，分属 3 个采集编号。记录所列现代地点为：UZ / Navoi; UZ / Karakalpakstan。记录给出的年代标签为 Early Cenomanian。返回采集记录的年代区间外界为距今 100.5 至 93.9 百万年。这些年代区间附属于检索返回的采集记录，不是该物种起源或灭绝日期；这份快照也不能证明全球化石分布已经完整记录。

title.en: Scope of the available biological evidence
title.zh: 现有资料能说明什么

text.en: The indexed references attached to this record are bibliographic leads, not verified biological claims. This page therefore describes the PBDB name and placement and the occurrence information returned in the captured query; it cannot support a description of anatomy, life history or ecology.
text.zh: 此条目关联的引文索引提供书目线索，尚未形成经核对的生物学主张。因此，本页只说明 PBDB 所记名称与分类位置，以及本次捕获查询返回的出现记录；这些资料不足以描述形态、生活史或生态。

title.zh: 来源记载的化石概念

text.en: In the PBDB snapshot, Scapherpeton tectum is recorded at species rank. This page follows the database name and taxon concept; a classification record is not a description of an individual fossil specimen.
text.zh: PBDB 快照将 Scapherpeton tectum 记为种级分类概念。本页沿用数据库中的名称与分类概念；分类记录本身不是某件化石标本的描述。

title.zh: 化石出现记录

text.en: The PBDB snapshot links 132 occurrence rows to 132 collection IDs. The rows contain 18 distinct locality labels. The rows contain 21 distinct stratigraphic labels. The listed collection intervals extend from the oldest bound, 83.6 Ma, to the youngest bound, 57.5 Ma (Ma means million years ago). These ages and places belong to the listed database records; they are not a measured origin, extinction date, or complete global range for the taxon.
text.zh: PBDB 快照将 132 条出现记录关联到 132 个采集地 ID。这些行包含 18 个不同的地点标签。这些行包含 21 个不同的地层标签。所列采集地年代区间的较老外侧边界为 83.6 Ma，较新外侧边界为 57.5 Ma（Ma 表示距今百万年）。这些年代与地点属于所列数据库记录，不能当作测定的起源、灭绝时间或完整全球分布。

title.zh: 研究正文待整理

title.zh: 来源记载的化石概念

text.en: In the PBDB snapshot, Plioambystoma kansensis Adams and Martin 1929 is recorded at species rank, with Plioambystoma as its listed parent. This placement comes from the database snapshot dated 2 October 2026. It is a supplementary fossil classification and does not establish equivalence with a similarly named COL concept.
text.zh: 在 PBDB 快照中，Plioambystoma kansensis Adams and Martin 1929 被记为种级，所列上级为 Plioambystoma。该分类取自日期为 2026 年 10 月 2 日的数据库快照。这是补充化石分类，不能据此认定它与 COL 中同名概念等同。

title.zh: 化石出现记录

text.en: The captured query returns 1 occurrence records for this exact PBDB concept, representing 1 collection IDs. Its recorded modern geographic labels are US / Kansas / Sherman. The supplied interval labels are Hemphillian. Across these collection-age intervals, the outer bounds span 9.4–4.7 million years ago. These dates describe collections in the database, not the taxon’s origin or extinction. The snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 针对这一 PBDB 分类概念，捕获查询返回 1 条出现记录，对应 1 个 collection 编号。数据库记录的现代地理标签为 US / Kansas / Sherman。所给年代标签为 Hemphillian。这些采集年龄区间的外侧边界为距今 9.4–4.7 百万年，描述的是数据库中的采集记录，不是该分类单元的起源或灭绝时间。此快照不能证明全球化石分布完整。

title.zh: 研究正文待整理

This page therefore stays with the PBDB name, classification, and occurrence information above. The available record does not support adding claims about anatomy, life history, ecology, or evolutionary relationships.

title.zh: 来源记载的化石概念

text.en: In the PBDB snapshot, Nigerpeton ricqlesi Sidor et al. 2005 is recorded at species rank, with Nigerpeton as its listed parent. This placement comes from the database snapshot dated 2 October 2026. It is a supplementary fossil classification and does not establish equivalence with a similarly named COL concept.
text.zh: 在 PBDB 快照中，Nigerpeton ricqlesi Sidor et al. 2005 被记为种级，所列上级为 Nigerpeton。该分类取自日期为 2026 年 10 月 2 日的数据库快照。这是补充化石分类，不能据此认定它与 COL 中同名概念等同。

title.zh: 化石出现记录

text.en: The captured query returns 2 occurrence records for this exact PBDB concept, representing 2 collection IDs. Its recorded modern geographic labels are NE / Agadez / Arlit. The supplied interval labels are Changhsingian. Across these collection-age intervals, the outer bounds span 254.14–251.902 million years ago. These dates describe collections in the database, not the taxon’s origin or extinction. The snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 针对这一 PBDB 分类概念，捕获查询返回 2 条出现记录，对应 2 个 collection 编号。数据库记录的现代地理标签为 NE / Agadez / Arlit。所给年代标签为 Changhsingian。这些采集年龄区间的外侧边界为距今 254.14–251.902 百万年，描述的是数据库中的采集记录，不是该分类单元的起源或灭绝时间。此快照不能证明全球化石分布完整。

title.zh: 研究正文待整理

text.en: A separate literature index is recorded for this taxon, but an index documents citation searching rather than verified biological findings. This page therefore stays with the PBDB name, classification, and occurrence information above. The available record does not support adding claims about anatomy, life history, ecology, or evolutionary relationships.
text.zh: 另有文献索引记录，但索引反映的是引文检索状态，并不等于已证实的生物学发现。因此本页仅介绍上文的 PBDB 名称、分类和出现记录；现有记录不足以补写解剖、生活史、生态或演化关系。

These are age intervals attached to returned collections, not a measured species origin or extinction date, and the snapshot does not establish a complete global fossil distribution.
